notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40855902/811ab8cb8e661cba7d77481018750d2a7e3e6d23.png
Dear everyone! Thank you very much for supporting the game and contributing to the amazing launch that Beautiful Mystic Defenders had. Our game was featured on the front page of Steam for about a week, which is a dream come true for us!

And thanks to everyone's valuable feedback and bug reports, we have made the following bug fixes and game balancing in the current release.

Gameplay changes:

 Player can now refund upgrades for towers and heroines.
 Bile Launcher now deals hybrid damage and has a stronger slow effect.
 Balancing prices and power of several towers.
 Sumi's bombs can now stack and only last a limited time.


Bug fixes:

 Fixed a bug where the game is stuck when the first dialogue is played.
 Fixed a bug where Sumi and Airi couldn't move over their bombs and swamps.
 Fixed a bug where save files can't be deleted.
 Fixed a bug where the sound/music disappears after the game is played at high speed.
 Fixed a bug where air enemies block the player from selecting a tower.
 Fixed several translation issues.
 Other small bug fixes.
